concepts.name: 书页成门
concepts.direction: Number text “01”. A minimal open book whose central negative space forms an inviting tall doorway. The two pages are asymmetrical subtly curved planes, not a generic clip-art outline. The doorway represents entering literature through translation. Green mark, paper background. Aim for a memorable architectural silhouette with 3–5 broad shapes.
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: first-round logo exploration for the native iOS book translation and reading app named “译间” (BookLLM).
Create one polished square logo concept presentation, front-facing, flat graphic design. The product turns foreign-language books into readable translations with chapter-aware AI editorial review and a quiet paper-based reading experience.
Brand character: thoughtful, literary, calm, contemporary, approachable. Vector-friendly precise edges, strong original silhouette, restrained detail, legible as a small app icon. Use paper ivory #F6F4EE, ink green #525F50 and charcoal #302F2C unless a concept specifies an accent. Flat fills or sturdy clean strokes, generous negative space. No gradients, 3D, shadows, mockup devices, photographic texture, robots, sparkles, globes, national flags or stock translation A/文 symbols.
Composition: large standalone symbol centered in upper-middle; exact Chinese wordmark “译间” centered below in refined contemporary Song/Ming typography, accurately typeset with only these two characters. A small restrained two-digit concept number at top left. Along the bottom show a small rounded-square app-icon adaptation with the same mark, paper background, no wordmark, to demonstrate small-scale recognizability. Keep all elements fully visible with spacious margins. No explanatory paragraphs, no other text, no decorative frame.
Concept-specific direction:
Number text “01”. A minimal open book whose central negative space forms an inviting tall doorway. The two pages are asymmetrical subtly curved planes, not a generic clip-art outline. The doorway represents entering literature through translation. Green mark, paper background. Aim for a memorable architectural silhouette with 3–5 broad shapes.

concepts.name: 双页对话
concepts.direction: Number text “02”. Two interlocking page-shaped dialogue forms facing one another, representing source and translation. One dark ink-green plane and one outlined plane, same visual weight; their overlap forms a quiet book spine. A compact balanced monogram-like symbol, mildly rounded page corners, broad negative spaces. Do not use arrows or letter symbols. Make it visually different from an ordinary open book.

concepts.name: 间字书窗
concepts.direction: Number text “03”. A bold contemporary custom typographic emblem derived from the actual simplified Chinese character “间”: its outer door radical becomes a nearly square architectural frame, and the inner 日 becomes a small book-window with two readable page bands. Preserve recognition of “间” while making it elegant and icon-ready. Sturdy green strokes, clever negative space, minimal geometry, no ornamental calligraphy. The wordmark below is “译间”.

concepts.name: 译字印记
concepts.direction: Number text “04”. A contemporary Chinese publisher's seal with the actual simplified character “译” as its central customized typographic motif. Muted cinnabar red #A45B48 is the only accent for the compact square seal; charcoal wordmark on paper. Use substantial simplified strokes with generous negative space, modern restrained seal-inspired construction rather than dense ancient seal script. Slightly human line character but clean crisp edges; suitable for a refined literary app. Keep “译” recognizable and “译间” below accurate.

concepts.name: 编织书页
concepts.direction: Number text “05”. A distinctive abstract editorial mark made of three broad folded paper ribbons woven together into one compact upright emblem, like several drafts becoming one finished book. Carefully alternate ink-green filled strips and paper negative-space cuts. Architectural, crisp, minimalist and warm. No infinity symbol, no knot complexity, no arrows; only 3–4 robust interlocking shapes that work small. This should feel like a modern literary publisher's emblem, not a generic book outline.

concepts.name: 墨滴藏书
concepts.direction: Number text “06”. A single confident ink-green droplet silhouette, with a tiny open book revealed through broad ivory negative-space cuts in the lower half. The droplet means language written into a book. An elegant solid mark with soft asymmetric human warmth and a slightly rounded apex, avoiding fountain pen clip-art. Only one filled silhouette and two or three cutouts; high recognizability at app-icon size. No literal splash, no gradients, no detailed pages.
